text:
```yaml
name: Push Kubernetes Manifests to GHCR

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'overlays/x86/**'

jobs:
  push-manifests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Dockerfile for manifests
        run: |
          cat <<EOF > Dockerfile.manifests
          FROM scratch
          COPY overlays/x86 /manifests
          EOF

      - name: Build and push manifests
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile.manifests
          push: true
          tags: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/htk8s:overlays-x86-${{ github.sha }}
```
